Release: RC6 stabilization -- PinnAPI feed recovery (an eviction loop stands down 30 min, 1 h, 2 h, then 4 h and re-enters once instead of ending the feed until a restart, PINNAPI_EVICTION_STANDDOWN=off restores the permanent refusal; a close this client made is never an eviction; the pong deadline is the provider's 75 s silence window; our own repeated closes back off on the connected clock; an ambiguous close is UNKNOWN; the held watch targets the fixtures the held reads price), API event-loop work moved off the loop (intel shadow cycle, pair-observation reads) with the watchdog naming the holder, market-plane bounded REST refresh of quiet priority members inside the unchanged 300 s bound (<= 12 reads/min, UMP_ACTIVE_REFRESH=off kill switch), decision-pipeline state judged over the last 24 h with all-time history labelled, Archer economic duplicates counted as current same-level refills after the producer fix, Audrey reconciles while the lane is stopped, fresh-database migration receipt bound by the judge, Trader device acceptance in the scorecard (tree of dfb474de). Stabilization only, not full-system completion. Previous running release 69a8a07e kept for rollback. SMALL LIVE = SHADOW, KALSHI LIVE MONEY = NOT ACTIVATED, ADRIANA = SHADOW ONLY, HISTORICAL PAPER = UNCHANGED, NO AUTHORITY EXPANDED [deploy-approved]

Release: RC6.1 operational PAPER/SHADOW release -- Xavier management records on every held paper position (identity, remaining quantity, probability with its source / receipt / verification clocks, action and alternatives, next review, actual order states, protection, exposure, named blockers; a metered-keyed held contract read on the PinnAPI fixture the matcher recorded), Archer order lifecycle and protection states verified (expired or rejected never protection, PAPER never conflated with venue-confirmed), red-team scenarios (a GAP book never re-stamped, another venue's key never signs, replayed or out-of-sequence Kalshi snapshots never applied, authority read from real state), Kalshi WebSocket sequence discipline reconciled across three lanes (a dead subscription never trusted until re-announced, a dropped market never revived by a late acknowledgement, one resubscribe per gap) and the Kalshi ontology for game winners / spreads / totals / team totals, API event-loop holders off the loop on one CPU lane with /healthz never queued on a saturated pool, frozen-window freshness measurement (the snapshot-only gRPC read stays OFF pending the owner), coverage read by the venue's event-slug grammar with the target-universe waterfall, Adriana void terms established only from contracts actually read, EV audit pricing fixes, the scorecard pins its evaluator and every input, live-game-state venue fixture adapter, and CI that runs every database proof in both required gates (tree of b3f1b0cd). Not a 95% acceptance claim. Previous running release 732cc0c6 kept for rollback.
